lcc_original: 給他起名叫挪亞，說：『永恆主曾咒詛這土地，以致我們操作勞苦；這兒子必【2】將我們安頓好了【2】，來減輕我們的操作、和我們手中的勞苦。』
notes: LCC reverses clause order (curse first → comfort second) versus UNV/Hebrew order (comfort first → curse second); all SNs redistributed to match LCC's restructured positions.

WH05162/WTH8762 (יְנַחֲמֵנוּ, 'will comfort us') mapped to 減輕 rather than 安頓好了, because 安頓好了 falls between footnote markers 【2】 indicating it is LCC's interpretive gloss; 減輕 is LCC's primary lexical translation of the Hebrew verb and directly governs the 操作...勞苦 objects that mirror the Hebrew מִמַּעֲשֵׂנוּ...יָדֵינוּ structure.
Standalone WH04480 (מִן, causal 'from/because of the ground') mapped to 以致, which carries the equivalent causal force in LCC's restructured sentence.

LCC's clause 以致我們操作勞苦 is an explanatory expansion not present as a separate clause in Hebrew; the 操作/勞苦 within it are left unannotated to avoid double-mapping; SNs WH04639, WH06093, WH03027 are placed on the structurally parallel phrase 減輕我們的操作...手中的勞苦 which directly mirrors the Hebrew.

{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) kept implicit and placed before 曾咒詛; LCC converts the Hebrew relative clause (אֲשֶׁר אֵרְרָהּ יְהוָה) into a main clause, leaving no explicit Chinese word for the relative pronoun.
